attachments.name: 20-2262 Early Childhood Education Verification of Closure Form - Governing Authority of the District

enrichment.headline: Certifies that early learning and child care programs have been closed for in-person instruction
enrichment.summary: The Board, acting as the district's governing authority, certifies that its Early Learning and Childcare (ELC) programs have been closed for in-person instruction since March 2020 because of COVID-19 health orders. It commits to hold a public hearing on the closure and prepare a safe reopening plan. The Board president signs the verification, and the Superintendent sends it to the California Department of Education.

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by Vice President Gonzales, seconded by President London, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.text: Adoption by the Board of Education, as the Governing Authority of the Oakland Unified School District,  of the Verification of Closure of Early Learning and Childcare (ELC) Programs; certifying that said Programs have been closed for in-person instruction due to a local or state public health order or guidance and by order of the Board since March 2020, due to COVID-19;  that at some point the Board will discuss in a Public Hearing the ELC Program closure and will prepare a plan for safely reopening the ELC Program no later than when the District campuses reopens for in-person instruction; authorizes the President of the Board to execute said Verification on behalf of the Board, as required by CA SB 820 and Education Code Section 8209;  and further authorize the Superintendent of Schools or designee to transmit said Verification to the California Department of Education forthwith.
items.title: Early Childhood Education Verification of Closure Form - Governing Authority of the District

attachments.name: 20-2006 Memorandum of Understanding - Girls Inc. of Alameda County - After School Program - Burckhalter Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Pays Girls Inc. of Alameda County up to $104,925 to run Burckhalter's after-school program

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $104,925.00

enrichment.summary: Girls Inc. of Alameda County will lead the after-school program at Burckhalter Elementary School. Its work includes program coordination, math intervention, homework support, student supervision and enrichment activities. The agreement runs September 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021, which began before this vote, and is paid from an After School Education and Safety (ASES) grant.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant

attachments.name: 20-2036 Amendment No. 4, Independent Consultant Agreement for Professional Services - Anthonio, Inc. - Foster Center - Inspector of Record (“IOR”) Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $24,107 and about six months to Anthonio's inspection contract for the Foster Center project

money.evidence: in an additional amount of $24,107.00

enrichment.summary: Anthonio, Inc. provides Inspector of Record services (on-site construction inspection) for the Foster Center project. This amendment adds $24,107 because of a rate increase, raising the contract limit from $1,265,050 to $1,289,157. It also extends the end date by 190 days, from May 29, 2020 to December 4, 2020, so the extension is being approved after the old end date.
